sources.note: Brief gives mm for length and kN for force.
Span x=300 mm, height y=60 mm upward, width z=60 mm; tool convention places minimum corner at origin.
Steel is stated. Elastic constants are not specified; assumed nominal isotropic steel E=210 kN/mm^2 (210 GPa), nu=0.30.
Brief specifies 0.25; tool applies this to non-passive design volume.
Brief specifies 1 mm elements: h=1 mm. Also specifies no member thinner than 3 mm: min_feature=3 mm.

Right bottom end edge across full width at x=300,y=0,z=0..60 mm is stated free to slide along x. Interpret as a guided bearing restraining y,z and permitting x.
Total 3 kN downward (-y) acts over full top face y=60 mm; shared equally across its nodes using tool load convention.
Stated empty duct, axis z, center x=150 mm,y=20 mm, spans full width z=0..60 mm; radius=16 mm diameter / 2=8 mm.
